description: This PHP source file interfaces with the Redmine API to retrieve issue details, create issues with XML payloads, and includes sample data and debugging code. It requires the 'redmine-rest-api.php' library and defines interactions with multiple Redmine instances.

classes.name: redmine
classes.description: A class representing the Redmine API client, used for retrieving and creating issues.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specified issue from Redmine.

methods.name: addIssueFromSimpleXML
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Redmine using a SimpleXML object.
